name: Dapta Forms (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted form builder with multi-step forms, conditional logic, lead scoring, submissions, webhooks and analytics; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Self-hosting only; provide your own server, PostgreSQL, TLS, authentication and email delivery. SQLite and local authentication stub are for development/evaluation, not secure production deployment. Hosted dforms.ai plan is separate and not included.
